heading.en: Letting go, but not of the outcome

hook.en: A captain can hand the ball to a bowler, but if the match is lost, the captain still answers for it. That is delegation in one line.
hook.kn: ನಾಯಕ ಚೆಂಡನ್ನು ಬೌಲರ್‌ಗೆ ಕೊಡಬಹುದು; ಪಂದ್ಯ ಸೋತರೆ ಉತ್ತರ ನಾಯಕನೇ ಕೊಡಬೇಕು. ಇದೇ ಅಧಿಕಾರ ನಿಯೋಜನೆ.

narration.en: A captain can hand the ball to a bowler, but if the match is lost, the captain still answers for it. That is delegation in one line.
narration.kn: ನಾಯಕ ಚೆಂಡನ್ನು ಬೌಲರ್‌ಗೆ ಕೊಡಬಹುದು; ಪಂದ್ಯ ಸೋತರೆ ಉತ್ತರ ನಾಯಕನೇ ಕೊಡಬೇಕು. ಇದೇ ಅಧಿಕಾರ ನಿಯೋಜನೆ.

body.en: Delegation is the downward transfer of authority from a superior to a subordinate. Its elements are authority, the right to command, which flows downward; responsibility, the obligation to perform the duty, which flows upward; and accountability, answerability for the final outcome, which cannot be delegated.

points.en: Authority: right to command, flows downward
Responsibility: obligation to perform, flows upward

narration.kn: ಅಧಿಕಾರ ನಿಯೋಜನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಮೇಲಧಿಕಾರಿಯಿಂದ ಅಧೀನರಿಗೆ ಅಧಿಕಾರ ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆ. ಅಧಿಕಾರ, ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಮೂರು ಅಂಶಗಳು; ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ನಿಯೋಜಿಸಲಾಗದು.

title.en: On the board: elements of delegation

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: Draw a superior at the top and a subordinate below.
Authority flows down from superior to subordinate.
Responsibility and accountability flow upward: the subordinate answers to the superior.
Authority can be delegated; accountability can never be delegated.

body.en: Decentralisation is the systematic delegation of authority at all levels, keeping only the most important decisions at the top. It develops initiative, builds managerial talent for the future, speeds up decisions, relieves top management, facilitates growth and gives better control. Delegation is compulsory; decentralisation is an optional policy.

points.en: Develops managerial talent for the future

body.en: Authority goes Away (down); Responsibility and Accountability Return (up). Authority can be passed on; Accountability always stays.

narration.en: Authority goes Away (down); Responsibility and Accountability Return (up). Authority can be passed on; Accountability always stays.

problem.en: The sales manager of a Mangaluru firm asks an executive to collect ₹5 lakh dues from dealers and gives him power to offer a 2% discount. The executive fails to collect. The MD questions the sales manager. Identify the elements of delegation.

steps.en: Power to offer a discount: authority, delegated downward.
The executive's duty to collect the dues: responsibility.
The MD questions the sales manager: accountability remains with the superior and cannot be delegated.

answer.en: Authority and responsibility were delegated, but the sales manager remains accountable.
